فَأْرَةٌ n. un. (but said by some to be fem.) of فَأْرٌ [q. v.] ―
-b2- Also, (S, M, O, K,) and ↓ فُؤْرَةٌ , (M, K, in the O written فُؤَرَة,) both with and without ء, (M, O,) A flatus (S, M, O, K) that collects (S) in the pastern (S, M, O, K) of a camel, (S,) or of a beast, (M, K,) or of a horse; (O;) which issues (S, M, O, K) when it is felt, (S,) or when it is stroked, and collects when it is left to itself. (M, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
